scope: Union of the first25 latest-created and first25 latest-updated actual issues. Pull requests excluded by query and item type.37 unique issue pages fetched; embedded body and initially loaded comments inspected, not all paginated comments. Last55 commit records and selected relevant diffs reviewed; this is not a claim that all repository issues were reproduced.

issues.title: [Bug] Opencode streaming tool_calls delta arrives with missing id / name / arguments, breaks tool-call reconstruction
issues.subject: Streaming empty/incomplete tool deltas
issues.analysis: Reproduced null/index-only Chat tool placeholders in the real SSE pipeline. Filter only semantically empty tool entries before native translator state and client framing; preserve valid fragments, opaque metadata, usage and native terminals. New nine-case regression and existing stream contracts pass locally; live provider acceptance was not tested.

issues.title: [BUG] OpenCode streaming requests are hard-cut off after 120s
issues.subject: OpenCode total-request120s cutoff
issues.analysis: Report targets open-sse/services/opencodeTlsClient.js/wreq-js, absent from Kitsune. Our OpenCode executor uses BaseExecutor; its response-header timeout is cleared after headers. No equivalent hard120s TLS deadline was found. Later comment references a PR, not reviewed.

issues.title: [Feature] Select OpenAI/Codex service tier via model ID variants
issues.subject: Model-ID service-tier modifiers
issues.analysis: Fork already supports independent body service_tier/provider defaults. A new (fast) suffix syntax is a new API feature and must not be confused with thinking effort or inserted as a transparent bugfix.

issues.title: Still no access to Haiku 5.5
issues.subject: Haiku5.5 missing from Claude OAuth list
issues.analysis: Native anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5 exists with reviewed metadata and native adaptive tests. Claude Code OAuth catalog intentionally does not claim that model; registry-metadata-sync tests explicitly preserve this distinction. A public vendor model does not establish subscription-route entitlement.

issues.title: [Bug] opencode free tier TLS fingerprint mismatch    +fix 429
issues.subject: OpenCode TLS/Bun fingerprint workaround
issues.analysis: Report proposes native/Bun transport to bypass remote acceptance gates. Fork lacks the same wreq module. No paid/entitled live acceptance evidence was collected; no new native dependency or insecure direct-egress fallback is justified by a public claim.

issues.title: [Bug] OpenCode free tier 429s whenever a declared tool name contains "terminal" — 9Router forwards tool names untouched
issues.subject: OpenCode terminal-named tools
issues.analysis: User-controlled declaration-name gate is reported, but no entitled live reproduction for this fork exists. Existing name restoration/typed-tool semantics must survive any future transport adaptation. Do not silently change tool safety descriptions or rotate egress to evade explicit quota/abuse denial.

issues.title: Problem: can't reliably generate Threads captions
issues.subject: Threads caption missing despite generation
issues.analysis: No exact route, wire body, request/response or terminal frame is supplied. Existing empty-output/terminal/combo fixtures are relevant, but cannot prove this user scenario fixed. No blanket fallback or answer fabrication added.

issues.title: [Bug]: DeepSeek API key validation fails as "Invalid" in provider settings
issues.subject: DeepSeek key validation
issues.analysis: Both current add-key validation and retest use authenticated GET https://api.deepseek.com/models with res.ok. This matches reporter successful curl. No contradictory endpoint bug reproduced; would need redacted failing status/transport evidence rather than another key or guessing a chat model.

issues.title: Feature Request: Official Community Hub for Verified Working Providers, Models, and Configurations
issues.subject: Community hub
issues.analysis: Discord/Telegram/community creation is external governance, not a routing stability bug. No messages or external community changes authorized/performed.

issues.title: [Feature] Privacy-safe diagnostic trace: per-request timeline + shareable bundle (allowlist-only, no content, no secrets)
issues.subject: Privacy-safe trace export
issues.analysis: Kitsune already replaces payloads/stream content with bounded structural metadata and strips URL query/userinfo; upstream claim that full payloads are always dumped does not match current fork. Headers still have explicit masking policy, not a universal safety proof. New exportable trace bundle needs separate allowlist/privacy/cardinality design.

issues.title: [Bug/Feature] Combo stalls under concurrent sessions until client timeout; add first-token failover and combo-to-combo fallback chain
issues.subject: Concurrent stalls/whole-seat budgets
issues.analysis: Kitsune peek is150ms, not upstream45s, and preserves paid reasoning/unknown/error streams. New Oct30 comment identifies real shared retry arithmetic:60s*(1+3)+3*3s=249s before account/combo can advance. Fork shares the same502 defaults. Whole-seat connect/TTFT budgets are not yet implemented; parent notified as performance candidate. Retrying/cancelling paid work must be reconciled before changing defaults. No default retry/deadline change applied: a whole-attempt policy requires separate cross-account/combo billing and cancellation semantics; local translator CPU results do not fix provider/header wait.

issues.title: [Security] Add SECURITY.md and enable private vulnerability reporting
issues.subject: Security policy/private reporting
issues.analysis: Source SECURITY.md and private reporting settings are governance tasks. No GitHub admin setting changed; supported version/response SLA/contact promises must not be invented.

issues.title: [Feature] Expose the served route in response headers (x-9router-provider / -model / -combo / -attempts)
issues.subject: Served-route response headers
issues.analysis: Public route identity intentionally echoes caller route; actual upstream diagnostics are separate. New provider/model/combo/attempt headers need explicit privacy and multi-attempt accounting contract. Not copied as an invisible bugfix.

issues.title: [Bug] DeepSeek Web fails on the npm build: open-sse/lib/deepseek-pow-hash.js is missing from the packaged app
issues.subject: DeepSeek Web PoW packaging
issues.analysis: DeepSeek Web executor/PoW worker modules do not exist in current direct API lane. Current DeepSeek uses official API and exact upstreamModelId aliases. Adding browser-auth provider is not a packaging bugfix.

issues.title: feat(custom-providers): user-defined response rules - auto-disable an exhausted account instead of retrying it into a ban
issues.subject: Editable response rules/account disabling
issues.analysis: Kitsune distinguishes request-scoped validation from account faults and terminal accounting failures. Generic regex/path rules with disable/retry actions are a new policy/security surface; blindly adopting them can cause charged replay, ReDoS, secret logging and healthy-account mutation.

issues.title: Streaming on codex lane fully buffered until after upstream EOF - client receives whole response ~2s late (v0.5.109)
issues.subject: Codex streaming before EOF
issues.analysis: Current codex-stream-before-eof.test.js exercises real chatCore/translator with an upstream deliberately held open; it passes. Native executor peek is bounded1s/256KiB. This proves synthetic core delivery, not live reverse-proxy/Next production behavior or entitlement.

issues.title: [Feature/Bug] Automatic background model synchronization for connected providers (OAuth/API) and dynamic /v1/models catalog refresh
issues.subject: Connected-provider live catalog
issues.analysis: Current /v1/models uses provider live resolvers and generic authenticated API-key catalogs with credential/proxy/import fences; explicit enabledModels selection is retained. Global models.dev metadata/price synchronization is distinct. A new background connected-provider scheduler is not required to describe existing dynamic discovery honestly.

issues.title: HTTP 502: [502]: wreq-js unavailable (Failed to load native module for win32-x64-msvc.
issues.subject: Missing wreq native Windows binding
issues.analysis: Kitsune has no wreq dependency/lazy TLS module. Adding unofficial/native binaries is a packaging feature, not a direct patch for this checkout. Native Windows validation unavailable here.

issues.title: [Bug] Tray fails to start on macOS: spawn Unknown system error -86
issues.subject: macOS tray spawn-86
issues.analysis: Current launcher uses maintained systray2 runtime, with executable-bit repair, but Apple Silicon native acceptance cannot be reproduced on Linux. Do not assert that newer package or chmod solves architecture/signing/Rosetta issues.

issues.title: Codex provider rejects Antigravity-format requests: "Invalid schema for function 'send_message'" / "response protection is unavailable" (IN 0 / OUT 0)
issues.subject: Antigravity ProtoJSON schema to Codex
issues.analysis: Six string-encoded numeric constraint types are normalized at Google schema ingress with safe-integer handling. upstream-google-schema-conversion/public fixtures pass; response-protection entitlement remains independently unverified.

issues.title: Dashboard "Enable Observability" is silently overridden by ENABLE_REQUEST_LOGS env var
issues.subject: Misleading observability toggle/env override
issues.analysis: Reproduced actual Profile SSR showing saved true while effective false, and inverse feature-flag override. Found second root cause: generic PATCH intentionally drops protected enableObservability while UI optimistically reported success. Added precise source/effective metadata, explicit guarded Boolean JSON route, effective/disabled UI with environment explanation, saved preference retained, truthful save errors; regression tests added.

issues.title: opencode HTTP 502
issues.subject: OpenCode wreq loader resolve failure
issues.analysis: Reported missing native loader is absent in fork. Comment about Codex rotation is separate incomplete reproduction; do not conflate provider authentication/affinity with wreq packaging.

issues.title: Bug: Kiro AI OAuth connections frequently failed: Token expired and refresh failed
issues.subject: Kiro OAuth expired/400 invalid_request
issues.analysis: Current refresh distinguishes external_idp/AWS IDC/social, retains client region, deduplicates by credential and transport, and applies stale commit fences. Report provides400 invalid_request but no redacted client-registration validity/region to establish source defect. Refresh transport fixtures pass; revocation/expiry still requires reauthorization.

issues.title: [Bug] Copilot context overflow becomes generic bad_request, blocking Codex Responses recovery
issues.subject: Copilot context error code lost
issues.analysis: Structured context_length_exceeded survives parser, account/combo routing and final Responses error event. Current upstream-context-overflow parser/routing fixtures pass. No live Codex compaction success claimed.

issues.title: [Bug] OpenCode Free via proxy pool bypasses wreq-js TLS impersonation (native fetch) — still 429
issues.subject: OpenCode proxy pool bypasses native TLS
issues.analysis: Specific wreq direct/proxy split is absent in Kitsune. Our strict/noauth proxy policy deliberately fails closed and does not retry quota/abuse via another IP. Comments claim session-level proxies/rotation success; not copied without native transport and policy review.

issues.title: Opencode Fix 502/429
issues.subject: OpenCode502/429 install workaround
issues.analysis: Issue and mixed success/failure comments point to external forks/native TLS dependencies. Same module gap as5325/5275; no proof that installing package alone establishes access, especially through configured proxy.

issues.title: OpenCode Fix 429
issues.subject: OpenCode env/session/Bun/egress workaround
issues.analysis: Body combines protocol fingerprint, native transport, session-clock, proxy identity, automatic quota egress rotation and packaging. Current fork has its own stable request-local session/decoy semantics and fail-closed proxy contract. Do not wholesale port this multi-feature external fork or change paid/quota semantics as a latency tweak.

issues.title: feat(combos): session stickiness for fallback and round-robin combos (prompt-cache retention)
issues.subject: Sticky fallback/round-robin sessions
issues.analysis: New opt-in affinity can change configured rotation and privacy/account caching scope. Current user request prioritizes stable semantics; parent was notified as separate model-cache latency feature requiring explicit lifecycle tests, not silently enabled routing.

issues.title: Combo empty-content peek re-runs thinking-only answers, hides stream errors, holds headers up to 45 s
issues.subject: Combo peek delays and paid reasoning replay
issues.analysis: Current combo PEEK_TIMEOUT_MS150 and tests preserve reasoning, tools, opaque thought, paid usage, native errors, fragmented bytes and read-error/deadline streams. Existing timeout/caller suites pass. No45s peek copied; last-member/one-member shortcuts and exact terminal proof retained.

issues.title: fix(codebuddy-intl): HTTP 400 Code 11128 "request illegal" due to failed channel verification
issues.subject: CodeBuddy Intl channel verification11128
issues.analysis: Canonical request/conversation/channel headers already adapted for both executors. Structured remote channel rejection can reflect account/WAF acceptance, not generic request validation. No broad substring backoff or new impersonation guarantees copied.

issues.title: Have any body got this error HTTP 429: [429]: {"type":"error","error":{"type":"FreeUsageLimitError","message":"Free usage limit reached. Subscribe to OpenCode Go to keep going: https://opencode.ai/go"}}
issues.subject: OpenCode FreeUsageLimitError
issues.analysis: Reported response combines quota, acceptance and TLS possibilities. Requires actual authorized account/transport evidence. It does not justify automatic IP/session rotation around exhausted or blocked quota; current noauth policy retains denial boundaries.

issues.title: [Bug] oc/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free publishes context_length 1000000 but the backend rejects above ~330K tokens; body-size cap is misreported as context_length_exceeded
issues.subject: OpenCode context/body-size distinction
issues.analysis: Current reviewed route metadata is narrower than blanket1M and supports operator declared capabilities/numeric ceilings, distinct context/input/output. Do not replace provider-scoped facts with one users330K/298K measurement. New comment confirms environment-specific variation. Source/public error fixtures distinguish explicit request-size errors; no automatic paid capacity probe added.

issues.title: GPT/Codex requests fail in Antigravity: `"1" is not of type "integer"` in tool schemas
issues.subject: Google ProtoJSON numeric tool constraints
issues.analysis: Current Google schema conversion normalizes six known int64 fields recursively, retains unsafe large values explicitly rather than rounds them, and preserves unrelated defaults. Relevant conversion/public fixtures pass.

issues.title: Non-streaming /v1/chat/completions requests receive an SSE-framed body; client parse fails and usage is lost
issues.subject: Omitted stream becomes JSON+DONE hybrid
issues.analysis: App defaults omitted Chat stream=false, core preserves native JSON and aggregates forced SSE when needed. Current nonstream/public protocol/usage contracts cover this boundary; no first-JSON-object truncation used because it loses tools/usage/errors.

issues.title: NVIDIA upstream connect timeouts (~250s) surface as 502
issues.subject: NVIDIA connect timeout249s
issues.analysis: Original body reports direct-provider slowness; new Oct30 comment exposes shared60s x4 retry multiplier. Fork BaseExecutor has same defaults. Caller abort remains terminal, but configured upstream connect/stall budgets can exceed common external deadlines. Parent notified; no claim provider network latency can be optimized by translator changes. No default retry/deadline change applied: a whole-attempt policy requires separate cross-account/combo billing and cancellation semantics; local translator CPU results do not fix provider/header wait.

issues.title: Antigravity MITM error
issues.subject: MITM Readable undefined
issues.analysis: Current proxyFetch.js explicitly imports Readable from node:stream and uses Readable.toWeb. Historical v22.18 environment is below current>=22.19 runtime minimum. No current missing-import defect found; Windows packaged behavior remains separate.

issues.title: [FEATURE] Add rerank endpoint support
issues.subject: Rerank endpoint
issues.analysis: A new service kind/route/adapter/accounting contract; absent current rerank route is an unimplemented feature, not existing translation correctness bug. Linked PRs not reviewed.
